question: Can frozen Understat event histories mechanically reconstruct prior-match score state well enough to support a strictly-prematch team response-profile screen on top of frozen Stage6 B?

nonduplication.historical_fusion_v3_shot_regime: uses rolling shot/xG quality, open-play/set-piece composition and finishing/keeper residuals, but not prior score-state-conditioned response intensities
nonduplication.c070g_state_duration: models within-match state duration and state-specific transition likelihood after kickoff; this audit only asks whether completed prior matches can form a prematch team response state
nonduplication.event_temporal_chance_burstiness: uses prior shot timing shares/concentration, not whether a team changes attack/defence intensity when tied, leading or trailing
nonduplication.r43af1_residual_volatility: uses prior team residual second moments/RMSE, not score-state tactical response

mechanics.goal_event_rule: result == Goal; penalties remain goals for score-state reconstruction
mechanics.response_shot_rule: nonpenalty shots only for xG response summaries
mechanics.observed_event_minutes_above_90: clip state-duration end to max(90, last observed minute) up to 120; do not alter event ordering
mechanics.invalid_history_match: exclude a completed match from response state if reconstructed Goal counts do not exactly equal official final score
